entry.title: Entry #25 in In re Amazon Ads SDK Litigation, 2:25-cv-00252
entry.summary: MINUTE ORDER (Text-only): The plaintiffs in the underlying cases, BJR-25-252 and BJR-25-261, have voluntarily dismissed without prejudice their claims against Defendants. See ECF Nos. 22, 23 . These dismissals moot the requirement for a consolidated amended complaint as ordered in ECF No. 13 . Therefore, the Clerk is hereby directed to re-file the Complaint, ECF No. 1, filed in BJR-25-700 in this case, and it shall be deemed the operative complaint. Defendants shall file a response on or before June 27, 2025. Authorized by Judge Barbara J. Rothstein. (MJV) (Entered: 05/30/2025)

entry.title: Entry #13 in In re Amazon Ads SDK Litigation, 2:25-cv-00252
entry.summary: ORDER: Having reviewed the Parties' 12 stipulation, and finding good cause exists for the requested relief, the Court hereby GRANTS the stipulation and establishes the following schedule: The above captioned actions shall be consolidated as In re Amazon Ads SDK Litigation, No. 2:25-cv-00252-BJR (W.D. Wash). Plaintiffs shall file a Consolidated Amended Complaint on or before 6/30/2025. Defendants will respond to the Consolidated Amended Complaint within 45 days after the filing of the Consolidated Amended Complaint. If Defendants respond by way of motion to dismiss, Plaintiffs shall file an opposition to the motion to dismiss within 45 days of the motion; Defendant shall have 21 days to file a reply. Signed by Judge Barbara J. Rothstein. (MJV) (Entered: 04/14/2025)
